summary: Month-end close, PR A (Ed 2026-10-09). A durable close record per community month (open / review / ready_to_close / closed; who, when, fingerprint of the books, accepted warnings, owner overrides, reopen), an append-only history of every checklist run, override, warning acceptance, close and reopen, required period sources (configuration) and evidence for 'other' sources. close_ledger_facts() computes the ledger integrity facts and the books' fingerprint in SQL. Closing a month locks every entry dated on or before it (months close in order and reopen newest first); triggers on journal_entries, journal_entry_lines and accounting_periods refuse any change into a closed month except the void flip after a reversal posted in an open month. Every close-table write is a SECURITY DEFINER function executable by service_role only; BLOCK overrides require the owner and a written reason; close/reopen/acceptance require admin or owner; reopen requires a written reason. Changes no existing row; the lock has no effect until a month is closed.

preflight.name: period_closes does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'period_closes'

preflight.name: no accounting period is closed or locked yet (the lock starts from a clean state)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM accounting_periods WHERE status IN ('closed', 'locked')

expected_changes: Creates period_closes (one per accounting period; status CHECK; closed rows carry who/when/run/fingerprint/label; FKs RESTRICT; written only inside the close functions via a guard trigger).
Creates period_close_runs (append-only; every control result PASS/WARNING/BLOCK with evidence hash; ledger facts; fingerprint; status_after computed on insert).

Creates period_close_events (append-only; seq; CHECK: a BLOCK override is the owner with a 10+ character reason and the evidence hash; a reopen is admin/owner with a 10+ character reason; acceptance and close are admin/owner on a run).
Creates close_source_requirements (configuration; a 10+ character reason) and period_close_evidence (append-only).

Adds guard triggers: accounting_periods status changes only through the close functions, locked is final, closed periods keep their dates; journal_entries and journal_entry_lines refuse insert/delete/change dated on/before the closed-through date or in a closed period, except the void flip after a reversal.

Functions close_closed_through, close_is_locked (callable by all roles; used by the triggers), close_ledger_facts, close_cycle_start, close_unresolved_blocks, close_previous_open_periods, close_ensure_record, close_record_run, close_override_block, close_accept_warnings, close_period, reopen_period, close_add_evidence (service_role only).
No row in any existing table changes; no period is created or closed.

verify.name: the journal entry, line and period lock triggers are installed
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_journal_entries_close_guard', 'trg_journal_entry_lines_close_guard', 'trg_accounting_periods_close_guard')

verify.name: runs, events and evidence are append-only
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_period_close_runs_append_only', 'trg_period_close_events_append_only', 'trg_period_close_evidence_append_only')

verify.name: the close functions are service_role only
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_function_privilege('service_role', 'close_period(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'close_period(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'close_override_block(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,text,text,uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'reopen_period(uuid,uuid,text,text,uuid,text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int

verify.name: the API cannot write the close tables directly
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'period_closes', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'period_close_events', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'period_close_runs', 'UPDATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
